The base was DERIVED, not chosen: git log --reverse over apps/web/src/lib/routes.ts gives the first commit that ever introduced the lane's own module, and this is that commit's parent. catalog-card.tsx was deliberately excluded from the derivation because the repository's root commit b484735 shipped a 14-line scaffold of it, which would have put the base before the repository existed and produced exactly the false field this path exists to prevent. The lane begins at b7bc31c, 'Four lanes: unforgeable pins, navigable results, persistence conflict rules, recommendation honesty' -- navigable results is this task -- and the missing apps/web/src/lib/routes.test.ts, named in this task's own allowedPaths, was added in 719d2d7. review.title: Search loses text typed before hydration
review.acceptance: Text typed into the search field before the form hydrates is not lost: on mount the form adopts the DOM value if it differs from its own state, and a query typed at any point becomes an addressable URL. Proven by an EXECUTED Playwright run on WebKit, where the race reproduces, rather than only on Chromium where it does not. Separately the spec addresses the result heading exactly rather than by substring, because role-name matching is substring by default and a query equal to a title matches both the results heading and the card heading -- a spec defect that only appeared once the suite was first executed.

unit.evidence: vitest via npm run check, exit 0, on the tree committed this round; the hydration-adoption decision is pure and tested without a DOM across nine cases including divergence, cleared-to-empty and non-hydration renders

e2e.evidence: Playwright executed in BOTH modes on 2026-09-05 at commit c47e1bba: production 78 passed / 0 failed / 18 skipped, development 87 passed / 0 failed / 9 skipped, across chromium, firefox, webkit and mobile-safari. The whole suite was green. This task's own proof, search.spec.ts 'text typed before hydration survives it', passed on all four browsers in both modes. In the previous run it was the only failure, and the cause was its own instrument rather than the product: page.unroute disposes routes without draining handlers still parked on the bundle gate, so each handler woke to find Playwright had already continued its route. It now uses unrouteAll with behavior wait. The assertions were also reordered so the address-bar check runs before the field-value check, because an UNHYDRATED field still holds what was typed into it and toHaveValue therefore passed even in the runs where React never arrived -- the URL is the only signal on this surface that cannot change without hydration, and it is the one that goes red if the adoption effect is deleted.

review.title: Review dependency scope and provenance reconciliation
review.acceptance: SCOPE EXPANDED, deliberately and on the reviewer's ruling: this task now covers two trust-boundary features in the same two files, because the review system binds an approval to a path range rather than to a semantic hunk, so a current-head review of these files cannot truthfully exclude the second. A nominal second task over the identical write surface was rejected as a fake logical split. (1) allowedPaths remains the sole write, collision and staging surface while review fingerprints, stale-review checks, approvals and the DONE gate bind to allowedPaths union reviewDependencies; two tasks with disjoint allowedPaths and a shared reviewDependency can be active simultaneously, and editing that shared dependency invalidates both reviews; tasks without reviewDependencies behave identically to before; a declaration that reduces to the repository root is refused rather than dropped, in validation and at point of use, and the autonomy guard treats root ownership as orchestration. (2) Provenance reconciliation: an implementation already present in COMMITTED GIT HISTORY can be started with a true implementationBaseSha via explicit flags that are refused on an ordinary start, the base is validated against mechanical facts only, the semantic question of whether it is really this implementation's predecessor is published as evidence for the reviewer rather than guessed at by a heuristic, and the audit event is distinguishable from an ordinary start. The contract says committed rather than pushed deliberately: the mechanism inspects the local worktree and the local graph and consults no remote, so a clean branch of never-pushed commits satisfies it, and claiming otherwise was the same class of provenance overclaim this task exists to remove. Remote availability is enforced where it actually matters, at review and handoff.
